title: My Unsung Hero: Justin Horner's Story

sentences.en: From Hidden Brain Media, I'm Shankar Vedantham.
sentences.zh: 我是香卡·维丹塔姆，欢迎收听 Hidden Brain Media 出品的节目。

sentences.en: This is My Unsung Hero.
sentences.zh: 这是《我的无名英雄》。

sentences.en: Stories where one person reached out to help another in a time of need.
sentences.zh: 讲述的是一个人在他人危难时刻伸出援手的故事。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: My Unsung Hero story is from a doctor I heard over 30 years ago.
sentences.zh: 我的无名英雄故事来自一位医生，我是在30多年前听他讲的。

sentences.en: He's an unsung hero because he rarely got any recognition for his huge heart and his unselfish actions.
sentences.zh: 他是一位无名英雄，因为他那颗宽广的心和无私的善举很少得到认可。

sentences.en: You mean the world to me and I can't thank you enough.
sentences.zh: 你对我而言意义非凡，我感激不尽。

sentences.en: Today's story comes from Justin Horner.
sentences.zh: 今天的故事来自贾斯汀·霍纳。

sentences.en: In 2011, Justin was driving down a busy freeway in Portland, Oregon, when his tire blew up.
sentences.zh: 2011年，贾斯汀在俄勒冈州波特兰市繁忙的高速公路上行驶时，轮胎爆了。

sentences.en: He had a spare, but he needed a jack.
sentences.zh: 他有备胎，但需要一个千斤顶。

sentences.en: So he made some big signs that said he needed help, put them in his car window, and waited on the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 于是他做了几块写着求助的大牌子，放在车窗里，在路边等待。

sentences.en: For three hours, no one stopped.
sentences.zh: 三个小时过去了，没有人停下来。

sentences.en: Then, right around the time he was about to give up and try to hitchhike, a van pulled up.
sentences.zh: 就在他快要放弃并打算搭便车时，一辆面包车停了下来。

sentences.en: And outbounded, I guess, what I would call my unsung heroes.
sentences.zh: 从车里走出来的，我想可以称之为我的无名英雄们。

sentences.en: It was a migrant working family, agricultural family, that was in Oregon picking fruit.
sentences.zh: 那是一个在俄勒冈州采摘水果的移民农业家庭。

sentences.en: And they didn't speak any English, save for their youngest daughter, who was probably like five or six.
sentences.zh: 他们除了最小的女儿（大概五六岁）外，都不会说英语。

sentences.en: She spoke a bit of English.
sentences.zh: 她会说一点英语。

sentences.en: And they just immediately set about helping.
sentences.zh: 他们立刻着手帮忙。

sentences.en: They came over, he unloaded his jack, and it was pretty obvious from the get-go that the jack was going to be too small.
sentences.zh: 他们走过来，他卸下了千斤顶，但从一开始就很明显，这个千斤顶太小了。

sentences.en: But the man was just, like, undeterred.
sentences.zh: 但那个人似乎毫不气馁。

sentences.en: The man seemed to know exactly what to do next.
sentences.zh: 他似乎很清楚接下来该怎么做。

sentences.en: First, he went back to his van and returned with a saw.
sentences.zh: 首先，他回到面包车里，拿出一把锯子。

sentences.en: Then he found a big log on the side of the road and cut a section out of it.
sentences.zh: 然后他在路边找到一根大圆木，锯下了一截。

sentences.en: Together, Justin and the man rolled the wood over to the car, put it under the jack, and managed to lift the car.
sentences.zh: 贾斯汀和那个人一起把木头滚到车边，垫在千斤顶下面，成功把车顶了起来。

sentences.en: Now, they just had to remove the busted wheel.
sentences.zh: 现在，他们只需要拆下坏掉的轮胎。

sentences.en: So the man gave Justin his lug wrench, and Justin started twisting the bolts out of the tire.
sentences.zh: 那个人把扳手给了贾斯汀，贾斯汀开始拧下轮胎上的螺栓。

sentences.en: But the wrench was flimsy, and before he knew it, it was broken.
sentences.zh: 但扳手质量太差，还没等他反应过来，就断了。

sentences.en: I just sheared the head clean off of it.
sentences.zh: 我直接把扳手头给拧断了。

sentences.en: And the guy just took it from me, and he immediately gave it to his wife.
sentences.zh: 那个人从我手里拿过扳手，立刻递给了他的妻子。

sentences.en: They had a short conversation, and she got in the van and took off.
sentences.zh: 他们简短地交谈了几句，她就上了面包车开走了。

sentences.en: It was explained to me that she was going to go replace it, and she was back in no time.
sentences.zh: 有人向我解释说她去换扳手了，没过多久她就回来了。

sentences.en: When she returned, we were able to get the wheel off, and we were able to get the spare on, and it was just amazing.
sentences.zh: 她回来后，我们成功拆下了旧轮胎，装上了备胎，真是太神奇了。

sentences.en: And, you know, when we got finished, she even produced this big water jug, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我们忙完后，她甚至拿出了一个大水壶，你知道的，

sentences.en: what you would dump on a coach at the end of a winning football game.
sentences.zh: 就是那种在橄榄球比赛获胜后往教练身上浇水的那种。

sentences.en: And we were able to wash our hands, and I just thanked them and thanked them and thanked them.
sentences.zh: 我们洗了手，我一遍又一遍地向他们道谢。

sentences.en: And I tried to give her money.
sentences.zh: 我试图给她钱。

sentences.en: I only had a $20 bill, and I just thought, you know, you drove around.
sentences.zh: 我身上只有一张20美元的钞票，我想，你们开车绕了这么久，

sentences.en: You've been here for an hour.
sentences.zh: 你们在这里待了一个小时。

sentences.en: It's the least I could do.
sentences.zh: 这是我唯一能做的了。

sentences.en: And she just wouldn't take it.
sentences.zh: 但她坚决不肯收。

sentences.en: And, you know, I understood, you know, they just wanted to help.
sentences.zh: 我明白，他们只是想帮忙。

sentences.en: But I was really adamant about giving them this money.
sentences.zh: 但我还是坚持要把钱给他们。

sentences.en: I eventually just kind of put it in her hand, and I just said, you know, there's no way I'm taking this money.
sentences.zh: 最后我硬把钱塞进她手里，我说，我绝不能不给这笔钱。

sentences.en: And I kind of walked away.
sentences.zh: 然后我走开了。

sentences.en: And it was when I walked away that their little girl called out, and she asked me if I was hungry.
sentences.zh: 就在我走开的时候，他们的小女儿叫住我，问我饿不饿。

sentences.en: And, in fact, I was starving.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我确实饿坏了。

sentences.en: I was on my way to lunch when I had the blowout.
sentences.zh: 我是在去吃午饭的路上爆胎的。

sentences.en: And she brought me a tamale from their cooler and thanked me, and I thanked her, and she jumped in the car, and they just took off.
sentences.zh: 她从冷藏箱里拿出一个玉米粽给我，向我道谢，我也向她道谢，她跳上车，他们就开走了。

sentences.en: And as they're trying to get into traffic, I unwrapped the tamale, and my money is in the tamale.
sentences.zh: 当他们正准备汇入车流时，我打开了玉米粽，发现我的钱就在里面。

sentences.en: Like, they had unwrapped the tamale, they'd put the $20 in, and then they'd wrapped it back up.
sentences.zh: 他们拆开了玉米粽，把20美元放进去，又重新包好了。

sentences.en: And I just immediately get out of the car, and I run up to the van.
sentences.zh: 我立刻下车，跑向那辆面包车。

sentences.en: He's still trying to get into traffic, and he rolls down his window.
sentences.zh: 他还在试图汇入车流，他摇下车窗。

sentences.en: He sees me coming, and he's just shaking his head.
sentences.zh: 他看到我跑过来，只是摇了摇头。

sentences.en: And I'm just, I keep saying, like, por favor, por favor.
sentences.zh: 我一直在说，求求你，求求你。

sentences.en: Like, I'm holding the bill out.
sentences.zh: 我把钞票举着。

sentences.en: And he just kind of puts his hand up, and he just, you know, with this big smile on his face, he just says,
sentences.zh: 他只是抬起手，脸上带着灿烂的笑容，说道：

sentences.en: Today you, tomorrow me.
sentences.zh: 今天是你，明天是我。

sentences.en: And he gave me a wave, and he rolled up the window, and drove onto the road, and took off.
sentences.zh: 他向我挥了挥手，摇上车窗，开上路，走了。

sentences.en: The last thing I saw was his daughter in the back, just waving goodbye.
sentences.zh: 我最后看到的是他女儿在后座向我挥手告别。

sentences.en: And I never saw him again.
sentences.zh: 我再也没见过他。

sentences.en: It's weird.
sentences.zh: 这很奇妙。

sentences.en: It's, it, it just seemed like some, you know, chicken soup for the soul kind of thing, right?
sentences.zh: 这感觉就像是某种《心灵鸡汤》里的故事，对吧？

sentences.en: Today you, tomorrow me.
sentences.zh: 今天是你，明天是我。

sentences.en: Like, it, it could have been you.
sentences.zh: 这可能发生在你身上。

sentences.en: It could have been me.
sentences.zh: 也可能发生在我身上。

sentences.en: But when you start taking it apart, it's, it's kind of big.
sentences.zh: 但当你深入思考时，你会发现这意义重大。

sentences.en: I think at the end of the day, it just shows you that everyone can be vulnerable in a given situation, and that everybody needs help.
sentences.zh: 我认为归根结底，它向你展示了每个人在特定情况下都可能脆弱，每个人都需要帮助。

sentences.en: Listener Justin Horner is from Portland, Oregon.
sentences.zh: 听众贾斯汀·霍纳来自俄勒冈州波特兰市。

sentences.en: If you enjoyed this episode, be sure to check out our new podcast, My Unsung Hero, where you'll find more stories like this that recognize people who step up in a moment of need.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢这一集，请务必关注我们的新播客《我的无名英雄》，在那里你会发现更多类似的故事，去赞美那些在他人危难时刻挺身而出的人。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham.
sentences.zh: 我是香卡·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: See you soon.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: See you soon.
sentences.zh: 再见。
